# Aura

> Aura is a free, private health app for iPhone. It tracks sleep, recovery, HRV, strain, training, body age, food and water. It works with WHOOP 4.0, 5.0 and MG straps without a WHOOP subscription, 38 Bluetooth smart scales and Apple Health. No account, no ads, no cloud. Not a medical device. Unofficial: not affiliated with WHOOP, Inc.

- [Download (latest release)](https://github.com/gdorgian/aura/releases/latest): IPA, installed with SideStore, AltStore or Sideloadly
- [GitHub](https://github.com/gdorgian/aura): README, FAQ and issues

## FAQ
- Use a WHOOP strap without a membership? Yes, Aura reads the strap over Bluetooth and never contacts WHOOP servers.
- Devices: WHOOP 4.0, 5.0, MG; 38 smart scales; Apple Health; imports from Strava, Hevy and other apps.
- Tracks: sleep stages and score, recovery, HRV, resting heart rate, strain, workouts, SpO2, skin temperature, body age, weight, bloodwork, food, water.
- Price: free. Not on the App Store. SideStore/AltStore source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gdorgian/aura/main/sidestore-source.json
- Languages: English, Georgian, German, Russian.
